name: CONFLUX
direction: Approved 01-C refinement: two matching orbital currents related by 180-degree rotation about (256,250), with a centered rounded flat-top hexagonal core. Signal-red upper current, charcoal lower current/core, and custom tall CONFLUX wordmark with a Signal-red diamond inside X.
description: An open-source Linux DJ application for arranging tracks with AI while the performer shapes EQ and effects. Brand application examples are concepts, not a shipped application.

fonts.wordmark: CONFLUX custom outlined artwork; not a font

assets.favicons: assets/favicons/favicon.svg, favicon.ico, apple-touch-icon.png, android-chrome-192x192.png, android-chrome-512x512.png, site.webmanifest
assets.fonts: assets/fonts/Barlow-Regular.ttf, Barlow-Medium.ttf, Barlow-SemiBold.ttf, BarlowCondensed-SemiBold.ttf, JetBrainsMono-Regular.ttf plus OFL licenses

rules.clearSpace: x = hexagonal core flat-to-flat height (approximately 174.94 master units); minimum external clear space = 0.5x.
rules.logoMinimum: Horizontal lockup 180 px / 40 mm. Stacked lockup 140 px / 32 mm. Wordmark 120 px / 28 mm. Standard symbol 32 px; simplified symbolic mark 16-24 px.
rules.icon: Use the supplied launcher tile without another frame. Where the host applies a mask, use the full-bleed maskable asset and preserve its safe area.
rules.ownership: DIRECTOR: selection, cues, transport, timing and crossfade. LIVE MIX: performer EQ and effects.
rules.motion: 160 ms micro interactions; 240 ms panel transitions; respect prefers-reduced-motion; no perpetual logo spin.

geometry.core: regular flat-top hexagon with quadratic rounded corners
